name: Congo Free State (1885–1908)

colors.symbolism: the darkness of the continent, per its founders

description: A blue field with a golden five-pointed star at the centre.
history: Flag of the Congo Free State, King Leopold II's personal colonial state whose rubber regime killed millions before Belgium annexed it in 1908. The blue-and-gold-star lived on in Belgian Congo and echoes in the modern DRC flag.
